description: A magical crafter and inventor who unlocks extraordinary capabilities in objects.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.tldr: Touch a tiny object to imbue it with one of several minor magical properties, such as a light or a recorded message.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You learn to invoke magic through your tools, preparing Intelligence-based spells from the artificer spell list.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.tldr: Learn special magical infusions and imbue them into mundane items, granting those items magical properties overnight.

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.tldr: Choose an area of specialization, granting features and spells related to your chosen focus.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.tldr: Magically create a set of artisan's tools in your hand, replacing another set you own, given an hour of work.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.tldr: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.tldr: When you or a creature you can see fails an ability check or saving throw, use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.tldr: Attune to up to four magic items at once, and gain the ability to craft common and uncommon magic items more quickly and cheaply.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.tldr: Store a spell of 1st or 2nd level in an object, letting another creature use your reserve of that spell later.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.tldr: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item, and attune to up to five items at once.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.tldr: Attune to up to six magic items at once, further expanding your capacity to wield magical gear.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.tldr: Gain a bonus to all saving throws for each magic item you're attuned to, and can prevent yourself from dropping to 0 hit points by destroying an attuned item.
